column1: # EXP-R2-225 Wave A, the pure-protein ladder: ProGen3-112M -> ProGen3-3B on
# ProteinGym substitutions (stage 20).
# BOTH rungs are scored here, not only the new one. The 2026-08-08 progen3-112m
# payload predates two things this wave needs: `scoring_stratum`, which
# scale_comparison.require_uniform_stratum refuses to assume from an arm name --
# "the field was introduced with this campaign, so its absence means the payload
# predates the rule and cannot vouch for what it was scored under" -- and the
# per-checkpoint `checkpoint` name inside the self-check record, which
# 43_second_stage_capability.py requires to be DISTINCT across the two rungs so a
# band borrowed from the other rung cannot pass as this one's qualification. So
# the older payload cannot be paired with a new one and is re-scored beside it.
# The rungs are bidirectional and belong to a stratum of their own. Both cells
# route through _ProGen3Scorer, whose estimand is the mean of the N-to-C and
# C-to-N summed log-likelihoods. That is not the summed left-to-right
# log-likelihood every N-to-C arm is read under, and WAVE_STRATUM checks the two
# payloads say so. Nothing from this campaign may be read in one column with the
# ProGen2 or ProLLaMA ladders.
# bfloat16 on both rungs, one precision per endpoint, which is what
# require_uniform_dtype resolves from the pair and what the existing 112M
# artefact already carries. Everything else is the stage's own default and the
# setting the frozen lookup.json was produced at: --variants 1000 --seed
# 20260807 --batch-size 16. The per-assay mutant_digest pins the variant set and
# align_dms refuses a payload whose digest disagrees with LOOKUP's, so those two
# numbers are not free.
# No --progen3-checkpoint on either cell, deliberately. One value cannot serve
# two rungs in one campaign, so PROGEN3_CHECKPOINTS resolves each rung's
# directory: the 112M keeps the module's TRANSFER_PROGEN3_DIR default and the 3B
# is addressed at ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR}/progen3-3b, which h200_env.sh
# declares. The self-check band is keyed by the loaded config's architecture
# fingerprint rather than by either directory name, so a relocated checkpoint is
# a KeyError there and never somebody else's number.
# The gate that makes these cells worth running is inside the loader and runs
# before any assay is scored: src.transfer.progen3.self_check refuses a load
# outside the band measured on that checkpoint. Stock from_pretrained on these
# releases returns randomly initialised experts and routers WITHOUT raising --
# 18.4764 nats/token against 2.2867 on the 112M, 11.7474 against 1.5045 on the
# 3B -- so a cell that dies here has produced the finding and must not be
# retried around.
# One slot, one card each, because there is no second stage to sequence: this
# wave carries the DMS endpoint alone. MegaScale is refused for the whole
# lineage at 29_designed_referent.py, and neither rung has or can have a stage-41
# record, ProGen3 having no ArmSpec for 01_cohort_power.py to resolve.
# 20_retrieval_bound.py's score stage reads wildtypes.json out of its own --out,
# which this runner injects, so that file is staged into each cell's output
# directory before dispatch. It is an INPUT staged beside a result and is not a
# cell's expect basename -- expect names the model payload exactly.
